Here, we make use of local scaling relations from (cite: Arnaud2010) to convert $Y_{\rm 500,c}$ to an SZ-derived halo mass, as robust scalings derived from high$-z$ clusters do not exist.

Furthermore, our analysis leads to an improved precision of the SZ mass estimate to $M_{500,\mathrm{c}} = 1.66^{+0.23}_{-0.20} \times 10^{14}~\rm M_\odot$, though we note the overall accuracy could still be affected by the hydrostatic mass biases common to SZ mass estimates.

For both observations with project code 2016.1.00698.S (PI: A. Mantz), calibrated datasets were obtained through the calibrated measurement set service (cite: Petry2020) of the European ALMA Regional Center using CASA 5.4.0.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00698.S and ADS/JAO.ALMA#2018.1.00478.S.
